posts.title: Me Before You
posts.description: Dear Diary, I once knew a girl in me who was mischievous, funky, a little crazy and full of life. She was an adult who felt like a newborn but with a well-matured body already. Nurturing and feeding herself, with little ideas to romanticize life, and living with it, was the energy that fuel of romanticism gave her. This girl feared not. posts.title: Aalu Dam (आलुदम )
